newsitem.title: FINLAND: NESTE SOLD PART OF FINNAIR STAKE.
newsitem.headline: NESTE SOLD PART OF FINNAIR STAKE.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said in its January-August interim report on Friday it had sold part of its holding in national airline Finnair Oy and booked an unspecified extraordinary gain.
Referring to its January-August accounts, Neste said extraordinary items were a profit of 84 million markka.
"The most important component of these items were gains from the sale of a part of Finnair shares," it said.
On March 31, the end of Finnair's 1995/96 financial year, Neste was with its 4.94 percent holding the airline's second biggest single owner next to the Finnish state.
On October 3, Neste's stake was 3.77 percent, a Finnair official said.
